entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to return something? I bought a jersey a while ago and I'm just so overwhelmed by the website. I couldn't figure it out.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, um, one moment... It's VF-886-2315. It's about this jersey. It's the wrong size and I was hoping for an exchange.
Thank you. I have your order pulled up now. Just so I'm clear on the situation, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference on the fit?

Oh, no, it's not damaged or anything. It's just... it's much too tight on me. I really thought I ordered the correct size, but I guess not. I just want to get this sorted out. The whole process is so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help. Let me just check the policy for you. I see here the item was delivered to you 82 days ago.
Yes, it's been a while. Is that a problem? I was so worried.
Not at all. According to our policy, standard items like this jersey are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so we can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I really thought I was going to be stuck with it. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll send it to the email address we have on file. You just need to print it, attach it to your package, and drop it at the post office. Would you like a full refund, or did you want to proceed with that exchange for a different size?
The exchange would be great! I just need the next size up, a Large.

Perfect. I've made a note on the account. As soon as we receive the original item, we will ship out the new jersey in size Large. You should receive that email with the return label within the next five minutes. Was there anything else I could assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, David. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
